title: Container test configuration
description: Schema for apps/*/container-test.yaml consumed by testhelpers.RunChecksFromYAML.

mainRunner.description: Optional dedicated main-runner configuration used only for health/file/http/tcp/healthCommands waits. mainRunner env/entrypoint/cmd are applied to that wait container, while expectedOutput/exitCode values are accepted but ignored.

runners.description: Runner definitions. Each runner specifies a container configuration (env, entrypoint/cmd) under which configured checks execute. When a runner sets expectedOutput, an output check is performed first. Wait checks run once on the dedicated main runner. When omitted, a single default runner is used.

http.description: HTTP readiness checks used for Container Health Checks in Containerforge. Each item waits for TCP listening on the same port first, then performs an HTTP request and validates status code.

tcp.description: TCP readiness checks used for Container Health Checks in Containerforge. Each item waits for a TCP port to become reachable inside the started container.

healthCommands.description: Exec-based health commands used for Container Health Checks in Containerforge, executed against an already running container after health/file/http/tcp checks. Each item is a wait-for exec command and supports optional exit code and output matching.

filePaths.description: File existence checks used for Container Health Checks in Containerforge. Each string is verified with `test -f` inside the container.

items.description: Absolute file path expected to exist in the container filesystem.

timeoutSeconds.description: Optional timeout for main-runner waits and all runner standard/output checks in seconds. Values below 180 are accepted in YAML, but runtime enforces a 180-second minimum.

readOnlyRootfs.description: Mounts the container root filesystem as read-only for all checks in the test suite.

mounts.description: Folders to mount from host tmp dirs into the container. A fresh temporary directory is created on the host for each entry and bind-mounted at the specified container path. Applies to every check run (http, tcp, filePaths, standard run).

runnerConfig.title: Runner config
runnerConfig.description: Configuration for a single runner. Each runner defines the container environment under which checks execute. Use entrypoint/cmd to override startup for this runner. When expectedOutput is set, an output check runs first and can optionally validate exitCode.

env.description: Environment variables to set in the container for this runner.

entrypoint.description: Override the container entrypoint for this runner.

cmd.description: Override container args/CMD for this runner.

expectedOutput.description: When non-empty, run the container (with entrypoint/cmd if set) and assert this string appears in the output.

exitCode.description: Optional expected container exit code for the runner output check. When omitted, output checks default to exit code 0.

disabled.description: When true on mainRunner, skips all main health/wait/file/healthCommands checks entirely. Has no effect on entries in runners[].

httpTestConfig.title: HTTP test
httpTestConfig.description: Configuration for a single HTTP readiness check used in Containerforge Container Health Checks.

port.description: Container port number to probe (string form, e.g. "8123").

path.description: HTTP path requested on the port. Defaults to `/` when omitted.

statusCode.description: Expected HTTP status code. Runtime defaults to 200 when omitted.

tcpTestConfig.title: TCP test
tcpTestConfig.description: Configuration for a single TCP listening check used in Containerforge Container Health Checks, using only a container port.

port.description: Container port number to wait on (string form, e.g. "8000").

commandTestConfig.title: Command test
commandTestConfig.description: Configuration for a single command check executed as `sh -c <command>`.

command.description: Shell command to execute inside the container.

expectedExitCode.description: Expected command exit code. Runtime defaults to 0 when omitted.

expectedContent.description: Expected substring in command output (container logs). Used only when matchContent is true.

matchContent.description: Enable substring matching against command output. When true, expectedContent must be present in output.

healthCommandTestConfig.title: Health command test
healthCommandTestConfig.description: Configuration for a single exec-based health command used in Containerforge Container Health Checks. Commands are executed as `sh -c <command>` while the container is running.

command.description: Shell command to execute inside the running container.

expectedExitCode.description: Expected command exit code. Runtime defaults to 0 when omitted.

expectedContent.description: Expected substring in command output. Used only when matchContent is true.

matchContent.description: Enable substring matching against command output.

nonEmptyString.description: String that must contain at least one non-whitespace character.

mountConfig.title: Mount config
mountConfig.description: Configuration for mounting a host tmp dir into the container at a specified path.

path.description: Absolute path inside the container where the tmp dir is mounted.

chmod.description: Optional permissions for the tmp dir in octal notation (e.g. "755").

chown.description: Optional ownership for the tmp dir in "uid:gid" notation (e.g. "568:568").
